programme_name: Master’s degree in Economics and Data Analysis
admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; procedure for assessing the required requirements

admission_routes.notes: ESSE3 eligibility check, then enrolment after a positive outcome.
EU-equivalent route where legally applicable; foreign qualifications are directed to the International Student Desk.
For eligible non-Italian citizens holding a foreign degree and not resident in Italy; followed by Universitaly visa pre-enrolment.

academic_requirements.summary: Three-year university degree/diploma or suitable foreign qualification, obtained by 31 December 2026. At least 12 CFU in SECS-S/01-06 and/or MAT/01-09, plus 48 CFU across the broad economics, statistics, law, mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering and social-science SSD list; up to 10% tolerance is permitted in one or more groups if 60 CFU total is met. A weighted average of at least 22/30 establishes adequate preparation; below that, an interview must be passed. Degrees older than 10 years require commission verification. The international pre-admission call additionally requires an Economics or closely related Economics/Statistics/Finance degree by 30 June 2026 and first-class or at least 85%-of-maximum CGPA.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: A suitable foreign Bachelor-equivalent. International call: Economics or a field related to Economics, Statistics and Finance.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: A tolerance up to 10% is allowed for one or more groups if at least 60 total CFU is met.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: Regular route: weighted average 22/30; a lower average triggers an interview. International call: first-class or at least 85% of the maximum grade/CGPA.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: All UNIVR economics graduates automatically satisfy the curricular-credit check. Other applicants are assessed against the credit groups; below-average and over-10-year cases require further verification.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: No general programme quota is stated. The international call separately ranks applicants for pre-admission and support, with a 60/100 pass threshold and results by 15 May 2026.

selection_components.notes: International-call interview only after at least 50/70 on curriculum plus CGPA.

language_requirements.summary: English proficiency of at least CEFR B2 is required. The international call accepts an official B2-equivalent certificate or a previous degree taught in English.
accepted_language_certificates: Certificates in UNIVR's official equivalence list
certificate_exemptions: Previous degree taught in English (international pre-admission call)
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted under the international call only for candidates from Iran and Afghanistan.

required_documents.document: Bachelor degree certificate or expected-completion evidence
required_documents.condition: Also provide Master's degree if the Bachelor lasted two years.
Modules/exams and, if possible, ECTS, weighted average, and grading range.
International-call exemption for previous English-taught degree.
Graduates/undergraduates from another university using the ESSE3 eligibility check.

document_legalisation_translation_rules: International-call transcripts must be in English. Programme-specific final legalisation/apostille rules were not stated on the reviewed programme page.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview / online international-call interview
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: Regular route: interview required below 22/30 weighted average. International call: 60/100 total pass, interview eligibility after 50/70 pre-interview points.
alternatives: No further check when all curricular requirements and the 22/30 preparation threshold are satisfied
entry_exam_or_test.notes: Interview topics are published in the How to enrol section; this is not a standardised admission test.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission fee, deductible from enrolment fees except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment €358 in 2026/27, with variable second and third instalments based on ISEEU/ISEE-equivalent calculations; international-call benefits can alter the amount.

double_degree_options.notes: Double-degree mobility; not initial programme admission.
